name: Fuel dock · North quay
description: Wait for a monohull to leave the fuel berth, come alongside the east quay, refuel and leave through the harbour entrance.
author: Leopard / Handling Lab

radio.yield: Monohull holding position: you are in its path. Give way.

steps.label: HOLD
steps.title: Wait for the fuel berth.
steps.hint: The monohull is refuelling. Keep your boat's centre inside the blue holding area south-east of the quay; it leaves 5 seconds after you are in position.
steps.linesRefused: Wait until the fuel berth is called clear

radio.start: Fuel berth occupied. Proceed to the holding area south-east of the quay and wait until called.
radio.enter: Holding area reached. Monohull departs in 5 seconds. Stay inside.
radio.reset: You left the holding area. The countdown restarts when you are back inside.
radio.done: Monohull departing the fuel berth. Keep clear and wait to be called.

steps.label: HOLD
steps.title: Wait for the fuel berth.
steps.hint: The monohull is leaving. Keep clear of the fuel berth and its approach lane until the radio calls it clear.
steps.linesRefused: Wait until the fuel berth is called clear

radio.done: Fuel berth clear. Proceed to Berth 01, bow north, starboard side to.

steps.label: APPROACH
steps.title: Approach North quay.
steps.hint: Enter the mint berth, bow north. Hold for 3 seconds, then attach lines from Crew & lines.

radio.done: Arrival confirmed. Deploy starboard fenders and make fast bow and stern lines.

steps.label: SECURE THE BOAT
steps.title: Make fast, without rushing.
steps.hint: Attach the first line to activate the amber alongside area. Use Crew & lines; either attachment order is allowed.
steps.hintAlongside: Amber area: settle alongside, not at the old centre point. Tend slack with Take in / Ease. Gentle covered fender contact is allowed.

radio.done: Secured alongside the fuel berth. Switch the engines off to begin the fuel service.

steps.label: SECURED · FUEL SERVICE
steps.title: Fuel service alongside.
steps.hint: Work through the checklist in order. Stay secured: fuelling stops if a line, fender or position requirement is lost.
steps.unsecured: Boat no longer secured — re-secure it to continue the service

items.label: Engines off
items.done: Engines off. Confirm the fuel type.

items.label: Fuel type

options.label: Petrol
options.refusal: This Leopard 42 has diesel engines — petrol would damage them. Choose diesel

items.done: Diesel confirmed. Start fuelling when ready.

items.label: Fuel
items.interrupted: Fuelling stopped at {amount} {unit}: boat no longer secured. Re-secure, then start fuelling again.

items.label: Pay
items.done: Payment received. Start the engines when ready.

radio.done: Service complete. Let go your lines and depart through the harbour entrance, keeping to the starboard side of the channel.

steps.label: DEPART
steps.title: Leave through the harbour entrance.
steps.hint: Let go both lines, ease off the quay and exit between the lights at the south-west gap. Keep to the starboard (west) side of the channel: red light on your starboard side going out.

radio.wrongSide: Keep to the starboard side of the channel: red light on your starboard side going out. +{penalty} s

rules.radio: Fuel berth not clear. Return to the holding area. +{penalty} s
rules.check: Stay out of the fuel berth until called

complete.title: Clear of the harbour.
complete.hint: Fuel mission complete with +{penalty} s penalties. Open the debrief for your score and one thing to try; Retry (R) to go again.
complete.radio: Clear of the harbour. Fuel mission complete in {time} s with +{penalty} s penalties.

tips.trafficClearance: You came within {gap} m of the {vessel}. Give moving traffic at least {clearance} m and let it pass before you move in.
tips.countdownResets: You drifted out of the holding area {count}×. Hold position against the wind with small, early lever corrections.
tips.earlyEntries: You entered the fuel berth before it was called clear. Wait in the holding area for the radio call.
tips.wrongSide: You left on the port side of the channel. Going out, keep the red light on your starboard side.
tips.fendersLate: Your starboard fenders were not out when you arrived. Deploy them during the approach: the crew needs 3 seconds.
tips.checklistRefusals: {count} {verb} refused. Follow the order: engines off, fuel type, fuel, pay, engines on.
tips.time: The mission took {minutes} minutes. Prepare fenders and plan the approach while you wait, so you are ready as soon as the berth is clear.
tips.failed: {failure}. Deploy starboard fenders before you get near other boats, and keep well clear of the monohull while it manoeuvres.
